$schema.description: The URL to the JSON schema (should be ../common/Schemas/manifest.schema.json)

name.description: The name of the addon. It typically does not contain spaces, but it is allowed.

version.description: Version representing the current update level. Semantic versioning recommended.

description.description: A basic description of what the addon does.

author.description: The name of you the developer.

authorId.description: Discord snowflake ID of the developer. This allows users to get in touch.

authorLink.description: Link to use for the author's name on the addon pages.

invite.description: A Discord invite code, useful for directing users to a support server.

donate.description: Link to donate to the developer.

patreon.description: Link to the Patreon of the developer.

source.description: Link to the source on GitHub of the addon.

runAt.description: When BetterDiscord should start the plugin. "connection" (default) runs on gateway connection; "idle" defers until the client is idle, to work around issues caused by lazy-loaded modules.

dependencies.description: npm packages this plugin imports. Installed before build and bundled into the compiled output like any other resolved import.

devDependencies.description: npm packages only needed for development/types, by convention not imported by the plugin. Note: the build does not enforce this — anything imported from here is bundled just like a regular dependency.

changelog.description: Changelog data shown via BetterDiscord's built-in changelog modal

title.description: Title to show in the modal header. Defaults to "What's New - <addon name>" if omitted.

subtitle.description: Title to show below the main header. Defaults to the changelog date and version if omitted.

date.description: The date of the latest changelog (YYYY-MM-DD)

video.description: YouTube link or URL of a video file to use as the changelog banner

poster.description: URL to use as the video freeze-frame poster

banner.description: URL to an image to use as the changelog banner

blurb.description: Text to show in the body of the changelog modal before the list of changes
Text to show below this entry's title

title.description: The title of this changelog entry
